topic: A person discovers their child has the same teacher they had
text: Well, would you look at that. Same old Mr. Thompson, still teaching at that same old elementary school after all these years. Guess some things never change, even when you've seen the world turn over a few times. I remember the way he’d pace the front of the room, hands behind his back, spouting off facts like he was reading from an encyclopedia. Now, here I am, bringing my little one through those same doors. Figures he'd be the one to mold young minds, just like he did mine. Funny how the years slip by, but you find yourself right back where you started, handing off the next generation to the same steady hands.
